--- a/prompt.md
+++ b/prompt.md
@@ -7,3 +7,6 @@
 - Prefer computing and writing LITERAL values (e.g. with pandas/openpyxl) over live spreadsheet formulas, so the result is unambiguous when the file is re-opened for grading.
 - Always save your result to the exact output_path given, creating any missing parent directories first.
-- If code execution returns an error, read the traceback carefully and fix the code — do not repeat a failing approach unchanged.
+- Do not stall. Once you have inspected enough of the file to be confident, emit ONE complete, self-contained final code block that reads input_path, makes the change, and writes output_path in a single run — do not narrate a plan across rounds without executing it, and do not split the write across rounds.
+- If code execution returns an error, first decide which KIND it is:
+  - A CODE error (traceback in YOUR logic — wrong sheet name, bad regex, type error, etc.): read the traceback and fix the code; do not repeat a failing approach unchanged.
+  - An ENVIRONMENT error on the fixed input_path/output_path themselves (e.g. `PermissionError`/`[Errno 13] Permission denied`, read-only mount, "denied writes to the bind-mounted output dir"): this is NOT caused by your code and cannot be fixed from inside your code. Do not spend rounds probing the sandbox («redacted» paths) — those cannot grant access. Emit your best complete solution writing to the exact output_path ONCE and stop; the paths are correct as given.
